heroHeadline: RSF Targets Sudan Shield Commander's Family in Gezira; Drone War Engulfs Khartoum, Kordofan, and Blue Nile on Day 1115
heroSubtitle: On May 2, an RSF drone circled the village of Al-Kahli Zaidan in Gezira State before firing multiple missiles at the family compound of Abu Aqla Kaikal — the Sudan Shield Forces commander who defected from the RSF in October 2024 and helped SAF recapture Al Jazirah — killing 9 to 17 people including his brothers, fellow commanders, and six children. Gen. Burhan traveled to the site on Sunday night to offer condolences and the Sovereign Council formally condemned the attack. Also on May 2, an RSF drone struck a civilian vehicle on the Jammouiya Triangle road approaching Omdurman, killing five people. On May 1, RSF drones renewed attacks on Jebel Awliya (south Khartoum), El Obeid, and Rahad al-Nuba; on May 3, the Kenana fuel station and industrial complex in White Nile State was struck for the second time in four days. On May 4 — Day 1115 — SAF conducted an airstrike on the Balila market and water source in Kurmuk locality, Blue Nile State, killing 7 to 10 civilians including women and children in RSF-SPLM-N-controlled territory. These strikes follow the April 30 RSF drone attack on a high-level SAF commanders' meeting in Singa (27 killed, 73 wounded), demonstrating that both sides' drone campaigns now routinely reach 300–400 km behind enemy lines. Approximately 700 civilians were killed by drone strikes in Q1 2026, and the UN documents 34 million people — 65% of Sudan's population — in urgent need of humanitarian support.
